criteria.source: Project Backlog row 27; Sprint Backlog III rows 31–33, 35 and 38
criteria.requirement: For an In Progress job, the marketer can submit a delivery URL as a Proof attachment and see the saved URL and upload timestamp.

criteria.source: Project Backlog row 27; Sprint Backlog III rows 30, 34 and 36
criteria.requirement: An attachment type outside Brief, Proof and Other is rejected. This form always submits Proof and does not offer binary file upload.
Proof submission is available only while the job is In Progress.

scenarios.title: Start with no proof
scenarios.trigger: The In Progress job and its saved-proof list have loaded successfully, with no rows.
scenarios.expected: Show one compact saved-proof workspace with an empty state and Add proof action. Opening Add proof reveals an inline Delivery link form in the same workspace.
scenarios.action: Open Add proof and enter a delivery link.

scenarios.title: Paste a delivery link
scenarios.trigger: The marketer enters a candidate delivery URL.
scenarios.expected: Show the Delivery link field above the saved list in one workspace. Keep the attachment type fixed internally to Proof. URL shape alone does not verify remote sharing permissions.

scenarios.title: Save once
scenarios.expected: Submit once and retain the draft until confirmation. Continue browsing closes the form while saving continues; View progress reopens it. A 12-second deadline or document return restores explicit uncertainty and check-before-retry.

scenarios.title: Proof is saved
scenarios.trigger: The save receives a confirmed success response.
scenarios.expected: Show one saved Proof URL and its server-generated timestamp. Clear the draft only after confirmation.
scenarios.action: Add another proof or review the saved evidence.

scenarios.title: Add another link
scenarios.trigger: The marketer starts a second proof while existing evidence is present.
scenarios.expected: Keep existing evidence visible below the inline form in the same saved-proof workspace.

scenarios.title: Review delivery evidence
scenarios.trigger: The saved-proof list contains multiple records.
scenarios.expected: Show full clickable URLs and timestamps newest first. Saving proof does not complete the job.
scenarios.action: Review a link or add another proof while the job is In Progress.

scenarios.title: Correct the URL
scenarios.trigger: The marketer submits an empty or malformed URL.
scenarios.expected: Keep the draft, show an inline field error, focus the input, and create no saved row.

scenarios.title: Attachment type rejected
scenarios.trigger: The simulated server rejects the Proof attachment type.
scenarios.expected: Show an explicit rejection, create no visible row, and retain the URL for recovery.

scenarios.title: Connection lost during save
scenarios.trigger: The save response is interrupted and its outcome is unknown.
scenarios.expected: Do not optimistically show a saved row or submit again. Read the authoritative list before deciding whether a retry is safe.

scenarios.title: Checked: link was not saved
scenarios.trigger: A successful reconciliation read confirms the new link is absent.
scenarios.expected: Keep the URL and make one explicit retry available. Never replay the original request automatically.
scenarios.action: Choose Save proof to make a new explicit attempt.

scenarios.title: Saved proof cannot load
scenarios.expected: Show a consistent top-left return, page header and one recovery group. Do not present failed loading as an empty list or enable submission without known context.

scenarios.title: Job status has changed
scenarios.trigger: A fresh response says the job is no longer In Progress.
scenarios.expected: Remove the submit action and refresh the job context before showing its current status.

scenarios.title: Access is no longer available
scenarios.trigger: The server denies access to the job.
scenarios.expected: Clear private job details, proof URLs, and the unsaved draft from the screen.

scenarios.title: Loading saved proof
scenarios.trigger: The initial job and saved-proof read is pending.
scenarios.expected: Show neutral progress and Stop waiting, plus navigation. After 12 seconds expose read recovery. Do not imply an empty list or enable submit while context is unknown.

presentationDecisions.precedence: Current human UX/UI guidance supersedes older presentation defaults; domain prerequisites remain unchanged.
presentationDecisions.loading: Close presentation without claiming rollback; keep background result/reopen affordance, 12-second unknown/read recovery and a same-tab fictional operation journal. Never replay a write on return.
presentationDecisions.pagination: Omit Previous entirely on the first page and Next on the last page.
presentationDecisions.copy: Keep only meaningful consequences, validation, uncertainty and next steps; do not repeat a visible status.
